title: b4joinacompany — Company Research for Job Seekers
description: An evidence-labeled decision-support platform for job seekers in Bangladesh to research a company before applying, interviewing, or accepting an offer. Combines **source-linked workplace stories**, reported work arrangements, community salary ranges, official company links, side-by-side comparisons, rules-based verification questions, cited AI answers, private research checkpoints, and a companion browser extension — without reducing unlike evidence to a score.

title: PostCraft — AI-Powered Social Media Manager
description: An AI-powered social media management platform that generates, scores, and publishes highly engaging posts for LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook. Features include **Gemini-powered variant generation**, automated engagement scoring, a dynamic brand guardrail system, trend analysis, and background job scheduling via **Inngest**.

title: DevTools — Developer Tools Suite
description: An open-source, privacy-first suite of **40+ browser-based developer tools** — formatters (JSON, Base64, URL), generators (UUID, QR codes, passwords, RSA keys), network utilities (API request builder, WebSocket tester), and reference tools (regex tester, HTTP status codes) — most running fully client-side. Backed by a full **Next.js 16 (App Router)** backend across **20 API routes**: JWT/OTP email auth, account-synced saved state, a URL shortener with click tracking, and password-protected, expiring share links.

title: Thoughtline — Chrome Extension
description: A user-controlled Chrome side-panel extension for understanding selected LinkedIn conversations and shaping writing in your own voice. Creates **bilingual summaries and four editable reply directions**, refines sourced or pasted posts with profile and style grounding, researches ideas across five public developer sources, and keeps inspectable local history. Uses **Gemini with Groq fallback**, encrypted bring-your-own keys, bounded passive extraction, manual publishing, and no analytics.

title: address-bd — npm package
description: A zero-dependency, TypeScript-first library providing instant access to Bangladesh address data with **8 divisions**, **64 districts**, and **495 upazilas**. Includes bilingual support (English + Bengali), fuzzy search, autocomplete, geo-coordinates, cascading dropdown helpers, and validation utilities.

title: Patient Portal — MyMedicalHub
description: A HIPAA-compliant healthcare SaaS platform enabling patients to complete **biometric assessments**, interact with **AI-powered chatbot intake**, view clinical reports, and connect with providers via **telemedicine** — across multiple tenant configurations.

title: Telemedicine Microservice — MyMedicalHub
description: A HIPAA-conscious telemedicine web application purpose-built for remote physical therapy and musculoskeletal rehabilitation. Bridges patients and licensed healthcare providers through **real-time video consultations**, **clinical-grade movement assessment**, and **AI-assisted repetition counting** as a multi-tenant SaaS solution.

title: Re-Annotation Microservice — MyMedicalHub
description: A client-side web application for post-processing and correcting biometric **ROM (Range of Motion)** measurement data. Providers review captured patient exercise frames on an **interactive Canvas**, manually adjust annotation overlays (lines, angles), and persist corrected measurements via RESTful API — serving as a standalone re-annotation microservice.

title: Book Heaven — AI-Powered Digital Library
description: A full-featured digital library platform with **AI-powered book chat (RAG)**, mood-based recommendations, auto-generated quizzes with gamification, a buy/sell marketplace with **real-time messaging**, Stripe subscriptions, and a comprehensive admin dashboard.

title: Shrnkly — URL Shortener
description: A modern URL management platform combining link shortening, text sharing, and QR code generation. Features **real-time click analytics** with geographic tracking, password-protected links, Google OAuth, **9-language i18n**, Redis caching, and a full dashboard with interactive charts.

title: Ramadan Clock — Sehri & Iftar Time Viewer
description: A Ramadan schedule viewer supporting all **64 districts** of Bangladesh with Aladhan API integration, PDF export, countdown timers, and a **DDD-based architecture**. Features admin dashboard with file upload, multi-layered caching, rate limiting, and comprehensive SEO with JSON-LD schemas.

title: BAUST CSE Student Archive
description: A secure, premium student directory and search API for the Computer Science and Engineering department of BAUST. Features **intelligent fuzzy search** with relevance scoring, **IP-based rate limiting** (60 req/min), **Base64-obfuscated database**, auto-search with debounce, advanced filters, and a modern dark mode UI built with **Tailwind CSS v4**.

title: TIN Audit Checker — Bangladesh
description: A client-side privacy-first tool to check if a Bangladesh TIN is selected for NBR Risk-Based Audit (AY 2023-24). Instant lookup across **72,342 returns** with **no data sent to any server** — all processing happens in the browser.

title: http-status-lite — npm package
description: An ultra-lightweight (**~5 KB**), type-safe utility covering all **64 IANA-registered HTTP status codes**. Provides constants, messages, reverse lookup, category checks (2xx–5xx), and full TypeScript union types — tree-shakeable with dual ESM/CJS support and zero runtime dependencies.

title: content-types-lite — npm package
description: A lightweight, immutable, zero-dependency collection of **50+ common MIME types** for TypeScript and JavaScript. Tree-shakeable with dual ESM/CJS support, full TypeScript union types, frozen constants, and categorized exports for text, structured data, binary, media, and streaming content types.

title: mime-types-lite — npm package
description: A lightweight, immutable collection of **80+ standardized MIME types** covering documents, images, video, audio, archives, web formats, and fonts. TypeScript-first with union types, frozen constants, and dual ESM/CJS support.

title: client-parser — npm package
description: A lightweight User Agent parser that detects device type, OS name and version, browser name and version, rendering engine, and mobile/tablet flags. Fully typed with TypeScript, dual ESM/CJS support, and zero dependencies.

title: Deshi Mula Extended — Chrome Extension
description: A lightweight Chrome extension for deshimula.com that decodes leet-speak company names, reveals contact and social badges on hover, and provides **AI-powered comment summaries** with sentiment analysis, multilingual translation, salary ranges, and live job postings via **Gemini Flash API**.
